strings.JNR_SWORDS_GREATSWORD_DESCRIPTION: A single-edged greatsword that is tattered and dull.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_GREATSWORD_SKILL_DESCRIPTION: Brace and step into a stance, becoming <style=cIsUtility>Implacable</style>. Using <style=cIsUtility>Primary Skill</style> during this unleashes an upward strike for <style=cIsDamage>750% damage</style>.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_DARKMOON_DESCRIPTION: A <style=cIsUtility>Legendary Armament</style> bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition.
strings.JNR_SWORDS_DARKMOON_SKILL_DESCRIPTION: Raise the sword aloft and become <style=cIsUtility>frost-touched</style> for a 10 seconds.
